title: Fresnel — FDTD Electromagnetics Lab
description: An interactive, quantitatively-validated Maxwell's-equations solver. Paint lenses, dispersive Drude/Lorentz metals and absorbers, drop in wave sources, and watch light refract, diffract, interfere and drive surface plasmons in real time — with a near-reflection-free convolutional PML boundary, a Poynting energy-flux view, and a Measurement lab that checks the engine against Fresnel, Drude and the FDTD dispersion relation.
